profile.Name: Longen
profile.Personality: Smart, self-assured, and fond of fine bloodrum. He plays the generous host but looks down on others, and sees escaped slaves as feral animals that need a leash.
profile.Backstory: He leads the slave-owning Traders Guild from its headquarters in Trader's Edge and has almost no rival in the Empire's trade. Tinfist and his ninjas free the Guild's slaves, and Longen promises a rich reward to whoever brings Tinfist down.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls the player "countryman" and pours a drink for guests. He turns shrill when threatened and screams for his guards.
